description: Venturi whose throat runs at vapour pressure, fixing the flow independent of downstream pressure.

parameters.name: Cd
parameters.meaning: Throat discharge coefficient (no generic published value in the library yet)

governing_equations.name: cavitating flow
governing_equations.form: \dot m = C_d A_t\sqrt{2\rho\,(p_{in}-p_v)}\quad \text{while}\ p_{out} < p_{in}-\Delta p_{recovery}
governing_equations.note: pressure-recovery limit of the diffuser is not given numerically in H&H; see gaps.md

valid_range: Downstream pressure low enough for throat cavitation.
